Class Context

java.lang.Object
org.iasi.setupdev.core.Context
public final class Context extends Object
Holds one single-threaded execution state, borrowed console streams and immutable original target selections.
Since:
0.1.0
History:
2026-11-19 | 0.1.0 | Establish structural documentation and component responsibilities., 2026-11-20 | 0.1.0 | Retain the OS identified by the process entry point.
